topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I can't quite shake the image of that empty space where the tree used to stand. It was a small sapling when I planted it, a fragile stick with a handful of leaves. Over the years, it grew with me, its branches reaching wide and high. It was a silent companion, a witness to all the laughter and tears. Now, the ground is bare, and the air feels different, thinner somehow. It's as if a part of my own history has been erased. I find myself wandering back to that spot often, almost expecting to see those familiar leaves, to feel the rough bark under my hand. But there's just the soil, silent and waiting, holding only memories now.
